resolution: Reconciled analysis Introduced(IH)->Engrossed(EH). (1) All 'December 31, 2027' dates corrected to 'December 31, 2028' across summary, top_lines, sections[1].detail, changes.added[0], and gaps[0] (filing deadline, revocation effective years, and subsection (b) effective date). (2) 'Medicare' removed from summary -- absent from the Engrossed source, which scopes the exemption to Social Security / title II only; the prior material flag is resolved by deletion. (3) likelihoodReason tightened to registered metadata (sponsor Fong R-CA, 21 cosponsors) plus permitted Zone-3 reasoning; named cosponsors Thompson/Kelly and the 'bipartisan' breadth claim were dropped because the Engrossed source removed the sponsor intro line and cache registers only the count.
notes: Audited against data/bill-text/119-HR-227.txt = H.R. 227 Engrossed in House (EH), Passed the House April 27, 2026. Pure-ASCII source (straight apostrophes, ``backtick'' quotes); dates read 'after December 31, 2028' (3 occurrences, no 2027). No referencedSources registered. Zero material flags after reconciliation. Remaining open rows are minor: the irrevocability gloss on the unfetched 1402(e)(4) statute, two coverage omissions (member of a religious order; lump-sum death payments), the extrinsic 'no credits for prior years' gap mechanics, and permitted Zone-3 likelihood metadata not present in bill text. Congressional Record featured_quotes/criticisms are out of scope for this bill-text audit.
